snippet.title: Above the Snow | Official Release Date Reveal Trailer ❄️
snippet.description:
The winter of the century has arrived. ❄️ Grab your map, pour a warm cup of tea, and prepare to manage the ultimate Alpine haven in the 1960s.

Above the Snow is a one-of-a-kind story-driven management game where you and a ragtag crew of friends run a mountain vacation business. From designing cozy interiors with mid-century furniture to rescuing stranded alpinists and mapping out dangerous trails, every decision determines if your resort survives the incoming Great Avalanche. 🏔️

Meet the crew, bond with Brutus the St. Bernard, and brace yourself for the harshest—but most rewarding—winter of your life.

📅 Release Date: 23.04.2026
🎮 Add to Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423760/Above_the_Snow/
